exposure: Gestational age (<20 weeks vs. >20 weeks in pregnant women)
cohort: 188 pregnant women and 799 age-matched non-pregnant women admitted to four tertiary care centers
finding: Pregnancy, particularly after 20 weeks gestation, was associated with increased morbidity from COVID-19, including higher rates of oxygen support, intensive care unit admission, and specific clinical symptoms.
mod_finding: Of the pregnant women who delivered during the study period, the majority (81.7%) underwent cesarean section.
